info.title: MICROSERVICE-testDev-Create Catalog Osprey Pendant Detail-v1-spec
info.description: The Osprey Pendant Detail Catalog API enables businesses to seamlessly add detailed information about Osprey pendants into their catalog. By leveraging this API, users can submit key attributes and specifications that enhance product listings, ensuring comprehensive visibility to consumers. This functionality is essential for retailers and e-commerce platforms looking to enrich their inventory with valuable product details. Typical consumers of this API include catalog managers, e-commerce developers, and inventory systems that require precise product data management.

post.description: This endpoint allows users to create new details for the Osprey Pendant. By providing the necessary information in the request body, you can successfully add new details related to this specific product, enhancing its listing and information available to customers.

requestBody.description: This request body contains the necessary parameters to create or update the details of an Osprey pendant. Ensure that all required fields are included in the request to successfully process the operation.

200.description: The request was successful, and the details for the Osprey pendant are returned.

CreateCatalogOspreyPendantDetailRequest.title: Osprey Pendant Details Request Body

osprey_pendant_id.description: The unique identifier for the Osprey pendant.

requestedBy.description: The name of the person requesting the pendant.

quantity.description: The number of Osprey pendants requested.

isPriority.description: Indicates if the request is a priority.

unitPrice.description: The price per unit of the Osprey pendant.
